name: refute_belief
description: Say that something you believed is shown wrong: one call for each belief. Name it by note_id if it is one of the notes listed, or quote it as claim if you never wrote it down; give exactly one of the two. Call nothing if nothing you believed is shown wrong.

note_id.description: The id of the listed note that is wrong.

claim.description: The belief, quoted, when no listed note holds it.

confidence.description: How firmly you held it then, not now: 1 is absolute uncertainty, 10 is complete conviction.
